title: Best Gyms in Wellington 2026 — CBD, Hutt Valley, and Kapiti
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Wellington, from CBD to Hutt Valley and Kapiti, with prices from $15/week
intro: Wellington's gym scene is thriving, with a range of options to suit all budgets and fitness levels. With prices starting from $15/week, there's never been a better time to get fit in the capital. From city-centre giants like Les Mills to local favourites in the Hutt Valley and Kapiti, we've got the lowdown on the best gyms in Wellington.

sections.heading: Wellington Gym Landscape
sections.body: The Wellington gym landscape is dominated by a few major players, including Les Mills, Anytime Fitness, and Jetts. However, there are also a number of independent gyms and studios offering specialized classes and training programs.

sections.heading: City-Centre Options
list: Anytime Fitness Wellington CBD: $24.95/week, no contract

sections.heading: Hutt Valley and Kapiti Options
sections.body: If you're based in the Hutt Valley or Kapiti, there are a number of gym options available to you. These include Les Mills Hutt City, Anytime Fitness Lower Hutt, and Jetts Paraparaumu.

sections.heading: Getting the Best Value
sections.body: To get the best value from your gym membership, it's essential to consider your fitness goals and budget. If you're looking for a low-cost option with no contract, CityFitness Wellington may be the best choice. However, if you're willing to commit to a 12-month contract, Les Mills or Jetts may offer better value in the long run.
